policy.public: Safe for public wording when the claim is architectural, visible on the site, or supported by a public source.
policy.verify: Useful but requires direct source review before amplification.
policy.hold: Do not publish without explicit review because the item is sensitive, private, or unsupported.

items.claim: 7YA.IO is the static public command surface for Igor Vepretski, 7YA, StartOn, Talk, Evidence, Radar, and Visual Podcast routes.
items.public_wording: 7YA.IO is the public command surface for Igor Vepretski and the 7YA ecosystem.

items.claim: Igor Vepretski is the person at the center of the site.
items.public_wording: Igor Vepretski is the public identity at the center of 7YA.IO.

items.claim: Numbers, rankings, approvals, endorsements, sponsorships, and institutional claims require a direct source before use.
items.public_wording: 7YA.IO does not use metrics, rankings, approvals, endorsements, or sponsorship claims without source review.

items.claim: StartOn is the social-impact lane on 7YA.IO.
items.public_wording: StartOn is presented as the social-impact lane of the 7YA public surface.

items.claim: Visual Podcast is the evidence-first media layer and does not claim fake metrics or unverified sponsorships.
items.public_wording: Visual Podcast is the evidence-first media route for stories, transcripts, clips, and source-aware publishing.

items.claim: Microsoft, NVIDIA, or similar technology program references may be mentioned only as technology directions or documented participation, not as sponsorship or endorsement unless verified.
items.public_wording: Technology-program context requires source review before public claims are expanded.

items.claim: Private people, raw allegations, rumors, personal contact data, and unsupported sensitive details are not public evidence assets.
items.public_wording: Sensitive or unsupported material is held out of the public surface.
